args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply
nested arrays, affecting fastjson < 2.9.4. Upgrade to the fixed version
2.9.4.

args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays, affecting all versions < 2.9.4.

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` (pinned fix version; stayed on the 2.x line rather than jumping to 3.x)

## Validation

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878`: **passed**
